title: Branch accounts
password: New password (8–72 characters, uppercase, lowercase and number)
sent: If eligible, a code will be sent to the stored email. Earlier codes for this purpose are invalidated.
done: Completed. Previous sessions of affected accounts have been revoked.
pending: Store saved, not ready to open. Track the account pair under Accounts.
lockConfirm: Change status and revoke all sessions of this account?
auditNotice: A shared account and session do not identify an employee. Managers only see Staff actions at their own branch.
unprovisioned: This branch has no Manager or Staff accounts yet.
recoveryMissing: Not configured; contact an Admin to set up the recovery email.
adminHelp: Admin assistance: primary OTP goes to the stored Admin email. Recovery changes also require the new email OTP.
managerHelp: Recovery changes require your current password and OTPs at both old and new emails.
manageSent: Challenge created. Check the correct recipient inbox; this challenge is bound to the current session.
